summary: Install-time fetch and execution of tarball from non-registry host
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `packet-table-thread-stream` as a direct URL to `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/packet-table-thread-stream`, and the shrinkwrap marks that dependency `hasInstallScript: true`. On `npm install`, npm downloads the tarball from this third-party host — outside the npm registry, not integrity-pinned, and unrelated to the stated `github.com/example/...` repository — and executes its lifecycle script on the installer's machine, granting the operator of `artifacts.yosiroute.com` arbitrary code execution during install. Package metadata is generic placeholder content (`description: "Generated package"`, author `"Package Registry"`, version `1.999.999`), consistent with a decoy lure whose only on-install effect is to resolve and run code from the external host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
